prompt: You are provisioning a new database on a running Redis Software cluster. Which settings can you set per database at creation time?
explanation: Each database gets its own memory limit (`memory_size`), its own endpoint port drawn from the 10000-19999 range (or an auto-assigned one if left blank), and its own proxy policy (single, all-master-shards, or all-nodes). The cluster FQDN is a cluster-wide setting that cannot even be changed after cluster creation, and the 20000-29999 shard traffic range is fixed cluster-wide and never per database.

options.text: The database's endpoint port, within the 10000-19999 range
The database's proxy policy (single, all-master-shards, or all-nodes)
The internal shard traffic port range 20000-29999
